fusions.name: Ceaseless Kicking
fusions.desc: Kicks out in a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Fatigued] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Run It Down
fusions.desc: Tramples a target at or below 25% health. It deals 22 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding the damage they had left.

fusions.name: Long-Ridden Lungs
fusions.desc: Your stamina recovers 50% faster for 18 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Winded
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you restore 5 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 15 seconds. Your armour rises by 8%.
